comment_source_reason: The post recruits new agents to join an insurance team, so nearly everyone answering is job-seeking for a role at that company -- explicitly a not_buyer for the insurance target client -- while the same kind of responder, when already independently licensed and running their own book, is exactly the self-employed professional solo_agency sells to.
